items.title: Why diesel prices are rising more than crude oil
items.description:
Prices at the pump for diesel and other fuels are hitting fresh highs as the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine have not only choked off crude supplies but also damaged refineries, with the resulting capacity constraints increasingly being felt.
How much crude is lacking?
French officials recently estimated that the global market is missing about 10 million barrels of crude oil per day.

items.title: Bodies of 2 FC personnel who went missing in Bannu recovered
items.description:
BANNU: The bodies of two Frontier Constabulary (FC) personnel who went missing a day earlier were recovered from the Kamali graveyard in Palosi, Rescue 1122 and local sources said on Monday.
The deceased personnel were identified as Havaldar Ishaq and Sepoy Umar Hayat. Both belonged to Platoon No 59.
According to sources, the personnel were allegedly abducted by unidentified armed men from Saifan Kozi Khel in the Karam Garhi area within the jurisdiction of Cantt police station on Sunday evening.
